title: A Review of Methods for Predicting Stock Volatility: A Comparison of Traditional Econometric Models, Implied Volatility, and Machine Learning Methods
idea: Compare a simple GARCH(1,1) forecast of next‑day realized volatility (using l_rv20 or l_rng) to a forecast that adds the 7‑day implied volatility (from the options pack) as an extra regressor, and evaluate which reduces out‑of‑sample QLIKE error.

title: The Limits of Machine Learning in Daily Return Forecasting: Evidence from Volatility Regimes, Tail Risk, and Multi-Asset Markets
idea: Enter a long (short) position in the S&P 500 (or QQQ) when the 5‑day rolling average of past daily log returns is positive (negative); exit or reverse the position the next day.
